listings.name: Demo Free Listing
listings.author: Example Audio
listings.summary: Free plugins are welcome in Other sources too. If your plugin is free but closed source, list it here with a link to your page and no support contact is needed. Developers: copy this file into catalog/listings/, change the fields and open a PR. Demo only: example.com link, delete when the first real listing is added.

listings.name: Demo Listing
listings.author: Example Audio
listings.summary: Make and sell plugins for MPC? This is the Other sources section: a card that links to your own shop, for paid or closed-source instruments and effects. Add a file to catalog/listings/ with a price, a link and a support contact, and your plugin shows here. Demo only: example.com links, delete when the first real listing is added.
